name: Decapitation Damage
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG. If the target's HP is below 25% or if the target is killed, refund the Arithmetica Cost. {STR} multiplies the effect by [Arg2] on {Decapitation Damage}.
lore:
The Philistine leader is a mighty warrior, wielding a giant blade that can fell foes with a single swing.
The Philistine leader is a cruel tyrant, ruthless and selfish, willing to sacrifice all his people to achieve his goals.
The former Philistine leader was a slave to desire, craving Power and ultimately ensnared by it.
